title: iPhone app, from a built shot to a live App Store listing
summary: The steps only the owner can take. TOHSENO builds the app; Apple requires a human for enrollment, identity, listing, and submission.

steps.title: Apple Account with two-factor authentication
steps.line: Turn on two-factor authentication for your Apple Account.

steps.title: Apple Developer Program enrollment
steps.line: Enroll in the Apple Developer Program. $99/year, your own card.

steps.title: Signing team selected
steps.line: Open the project in Xcode and pick your team under Signing.

steps.title: Bundle identifier registered
steps.line: Register this app's bundle identifier on the developer site.

steps.title: App record in App Store Connect
steps.line: Create the app record in App Store Connect using that bundle ID.

steps.title: Privacy policy URL
steps.line: Publish a privacy policy and paste its URL into App Store Connect.

steps.title: Privacy manifest and Required Reason APIs
steps.line: Confirm PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares every Required Reason API used.

steps.title: iPhone screenshots
steps.line: Capture at least 3 screenshots on a 6.9-inch iPhone.

steps.title: iPad screenshots
steps.line: Capture at least 3 screenshots on a 13-inch iPad Pro.

steps.title: App privacy labels
steps.line: Answer the App Privacy questions in App Store Connect.

steps.title: Age rating
steps.line: Complete the age rating questionnaire. Apple enforces it strictly now.

steps.title: Generative AI disclosure
steps.line: Disclose generated content and its age rating impact.

steps.title: Wallet and digital asset disclosure
steps.line: Expect extra review scrutiny: declare wallet behavior precisely.

steps.title: Build uploaded
steps.line: Archive the app and upload the build to App Store Connect.

steps.title: Tested on your own iPhone
steps.line: Install the TestFlight build on your iPhone and use it once.

steps.title: Submitted for review
steps.line: Submit for review. This one you cannot take back.
